findings.title: A unit with a null status is classified status_written, and the guard only counts, so it is loaded as NULL
findings.why_it_matters: classify() records the missing status only in statusPresent. planLoad compares the number of status_written outcomes with the number of units and never reads statusPresent, so the load goes ahead with NULL statuses, which the docstring says must stop it.
findings.suggested_fix: Classify a null status as rejected, or make the guard require statusPresent on every unit.
